security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-src 'none'

bundle.longDescription: Keeps notebooks of notes on your own disk as ordinary files, searchable across the whole archive, and records nothing about who wrote them.
